methods.text_en: Examine tactile detail in supplied body or object action without identity changes.
methods.text_zh: 近看已给身体或物件动作的触感细节，不改变身份。

methods.text_en: Use restrained handheld observation to retain intervals between existing actions without plot additions.
methods.text_zh: 以克制手持保持现有动作间的留白，不补情节。
